name: Mount Sharp boxwork, Gale crater: 3D terrain package
frame: USGS MSL Gale mosaic frame (eqc lon_0=0, Mars 2000 sphere R=3396190 m). NASA rover positions are native to it.
local_frame: x = metres east of the west edge, y = metres north of the south edge (eqc grid metres), z = elevation in m. True east-west ground distance = eqc distance x cos(lat) = x 0.9965 (0.35 % shorter); north-south is exact.

z.units: m relative to the Mars areoid, from the USGS MSL Gale DEM (same numbers as the rover's elev_geoid). MOLA laser shots suggest true areoid heights ~15 m higher (docs/METHODS.md, Layer 2).

vertical_exaggeration.note: display only; slopes and GO/NO-GO use true heights

heightmaps.order: row-major, first row = north edge, first column = west edge
row-major, first row = north edge, first column = west edge
